decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The approved residential units shall be used for the purpose specified on the application and for no other purpose, including any other purpose in Class. C3 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any Statutory Instrument revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification).

<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="line-height: 115%;">The
development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the
following approved plans and documents: Transport Statement 10th May
2021, Cover Letter 22 October 2025, Location Plan 23-25 Bridge Street, Existing
Floor Plans 871/Class O/01, 02, 03, 04, Proposed Floor Plans 871/Class O/05,
06, 07, 10, existing Elevations 871/Class O/08, Proposed Elevations 871/Class O/09,
Design and Access Statement prepared by David Corley Architect, Internal
Daylight Assessment prepared by Lumina London Ltd, Flood Risk Assessment and
Surface Water Drainage Strategy, prepared by Unda Consulting Ltd – May 2021,
Noise Impact Assessment Report, prepared by KP Acoustics Ltd – Report 23093.NIA.01.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">Prior to the first occupation of the development, details of
secured covered cycle storage (including elevations) shall be submitted to and
approved in writing by the local planning authority. At least 5% of the long
stay stand shall be accessible. The cycle storage shall be made available prior
to occupation of the approved residential units and shall be retained
thereafter.</p>
description: Change Of Use From Office (Class E) To 6 Self-Contained Flats on first, second and third floors (Class C3); (Prior Approval Of Transport & Highways Impacts Of The Development, Contamination Risks And Flooding Risks On The Site, and Impacts Of Noise From Commercial Premises On The Intended Occupiers Of The Development and provision of natural light in all habitable rooms)
